quotes.text: Young's steed, which unexpectedly sprang upon my horse, but instead of striking him, he took my knee into his jaw and bruised me considerably, sinking one tooth to the bone through three thicknesses of clothing and one of them buckskin.

Young's steed, which unexpectedly sprang upon my horse, but instead of striking him, he took my knee into his jaw and bruised me considerably, sinking one tooth to the bone through three thicknesses of clothing and one of them buckskin.

Brother Higinson and myself rolled his dead body in fine linen, and Brother Higinson stayed to see him put in the ground, about a mile from the place where lie was murdered. He lived two-and-a-half hours, and answered a number of questions asked him by the neighbours near the spot.
